name: post-revisions-history
title: 帖子编辑历史、版本对比与恢复
description: 记录帖子编辑版本，支持作者/版主查看差异、恢复版本和审计编辑行为。
creator: lijin

subtasks.title: Post revision DB model, schema comments, and Alembic migration
Edit history capture, author/moderator read APIs, and moderator restore
Frontend revision API/query wiring and PostItem history panel
Audit logs, search consistency tests, and code-spec updates

notes: Implemented post edit history and moderator restore. Every successful first-post edit stores the previous raw/cooked content with editor, version number, optional reason, summary, and audit log. Added author/moderator revision list/detail APIs, moderator-only restore that creates a new revision and updates live post/search content, frontend revision panel and restore action wiring, migration 0012, tests, and executable specs. Validation: ruff check passed; targeted revision/edit tests 6 passed; full API pytest 32 passed; pnpm web lint passed; pnpm web build passed; clean SQLite Alembic upgrade through 0012 passed; docker compose config passed; git diff --check passed with CRLF warnings only.
